title: 3932. Count K-th Roots in a Range

examples.explanation: The perfect cubes in the range [1, 9] are: 1 = 13 8 = 23 Hence, the answer is 2.
The perfect squares in the range [8, 30] are: 9 = 32 16 = 42 25 = 52 Hence, the answer is 3.
